journal.title: The books I don't finish
journal.body:
I used to think abandoning a book meant something about my attention span. Now I think it just means the book and I met at the wrong time. Some of them I'll pick back up in a year and love. Some of them I never will, and that's fine too.

I stopped keeping a guilt list of unfinished books a while ago. It didn't make me read more. It just made the reading feel like homework.

journal.title: Why I write reviews I don't publish
journal.body:
Not every book gets a review here. Some just get a paragraph in a notebook that no one will ever read, and I think that's the point of them. Writing it down is how I know what I actually thought, separate from what I want to have thought.

The published reviews are for other people. The unpublished ones are for me.

journal.title: A note to myself about slow weeks
journal.body: Some weeks I don't finish anything. No stories, no reviews, twelve pages into three different books. I used to treat that as a failure of discipline. I'm trying to treat it as just weather instead — something passing through, not a verdict on whether I'm still a person who reads.
